services.desc: Beaches & TurnoutsBoat LaunchesDeTour Reef LighthouseShipwrecks & Dive SitesFreighter WatchingFishing & ChartersKayakingPilot Boats We won’t tell where our best fishin’ holes are … but we will tell you that there is a lot of good fishin’ in DeTour. From spring spawning runs to fall salmon fishing, there’s always something biting. Whether you’re casting from the shore, launching a boat, or dropping a line through the ice, DeTour’s waters are teeming with gamefish and natural beauty. Purchase your fishing license online through Michigan’s Department of Natural Resources
